CTP Music Universe

Music is the entry point

CTP Music is a digital music and media ecosystem inside the CTPverse — internet radio discovery, independent artists, original CTP content and a living community, built on a lean modular stack instead of one heavy platform. A listener does not simply consume music here: they can become a community member, a student, a supporter, a creator, a Club CTP participant.

DiscoveryIndependent artists, unique radio channels, emerging creators, original CTP content.
CommunityDirect relationships between artists, fans, members and creators.
OwnershipCTP controls the brand, the experience, the community relationship and the membership ecosystem.
ExpansionA foundation ready for CTP-EOS, CTP University, hardware and future digital experiences.

Radio Wall

Every channel on one wall

Click a channel card and that channel's player comes up — stream, genre and now-playing, ready to listen. Channels with a laut.fm stream code in the directory play live; the rest are on the wall ready for their stream codes to drop in.

Bandcamp — Artist Ecosystem

Releases land here

Bandcamp is the portal's artist layer: releases, artist pages and direct support. No releases are loaded yet — when an artist's Bandcamp embed code arrives, it drops into the box below and the official Bandcamp player renders right here, one per release, stacked as deep as the wall needs.

Drop in a Bandcamp embed code

Channel Directory — channels.json

The portal runs on a static channel directory: one JSON file points every menu, wall card and the player at its stream. Paste a laut.fm stream URL into any channel's stream_url and that channel goes live everywhere on the portal at once.


              

                
                
                
              

            

          


          

            
Club CTP — Membership

            

              
Listeners → Members → Participants → Contributors

              
Club CTP is the membership and identity layer connecting the whole CTP ecosystem — CTP Music, CTP University and CTP-EOS under one membership. The portal comes first and the Marketplace later: community first, commerce second.

The Ecosystem & The Stack

            

              
One layer of the CTPverse

              

                
CTP MusicMusic · Artists · Media · Community

                
CTP UniversityEducation · Courses · Knowledge · Content

                
CTP-EOSOperating System · Hardware · Platform

                
Club CTPMembership · Identity · Benefits · Access

              

              
Modular architecture — each layer does one job

              
    
                
  • Experience layer — this portal, a static site on GitHub Pages (Vercel later, if community and database elements call for it).
    • 
                
  • Media infrastructure — Cloudflare R2 object storage with CDN delivery for CTP's own audio assets.
    • 
                
  • Internet radio layer — laut.fm streams, wired in through channels.json.
    • 
                
  • Artist ecosystem layer — Bandcamp releases and artist pages, embedded above.
    • 
                
  • Membership layer — Club CTP identity, access and tiers.
    • 
              

              
Separating the layers keeps the portal lean, secure and cheap to run — and free to scale when the community does.

            

          


          

            
Roadmap

            

              

                
Phase 1 — FoundationLaunch a fully functional CTP Music ecosystem.
  • GitHub Pages portal
  • Custom player + Radio Wall
  • laut.fm + Bandcamp integration

Phase 2 — CommunityIncrease participation, convert visitors into members.
  • Member profiles
  • Community features
  • Artist promotion tools
  • Events
  • Premium content

                
Phase 3 — MonetizationDevelop the revenue engines.
  • Membership tiers live
  • Advertising & sponsorships
  • Artist services
  • Commerce — the Marketplace

                
Phase 4 — Ecosystem IntegrationConnect the CTP platforms.
  • CTP-EOS integration
  • CTP University
  • CTP computer systems
  • Future digital experiences
